candidate_capture_rule.necessary: A canonical source unit or owned image supplies an identity anchor (an explicit/co-referential name, a finite specification, an unambiguously delimited unnamed referent, or a route that purports to resolve one) and a semantic anchor (a native law/denotation or an explicitly isolated coverage-bearing relation to such an object).
candidate_capture_rule.sufficient: Capture when both anchors are present, even if mechanics are incomplete. Also capture when a concrete source defect or contradiction prevents deciding an otherwise credible anchored referent.
candidate_capture_rule.nonqualifying: A name-drop, historical fact, analogy, observed behavior, incidental formula/statistic, renderer, application, or external term alone is not a candidate. It receives the corresponding reading disposition, secondary role, route, or source-status record.
candidate_capture_rule.formula_boundary: A formula qualifies when its function, relation, solution/model set, or query is itself the formal object under discussion; a calculation merely describing another object does not.
candidate_capture_rule.unnamed_boundary: An unnamed explicit mechanism qualifies. A named but purely historical mention does not.

candidate_id_policy.allocation_order: First immutable discovery epoch, then discovery-anchor occurrence in that epoch's frozen audit traversal, then the candidate's one-based within-anchor ordinal. INITIAL review events consume exactly the first unread canonical path: Stage 4 bookends in manifest order followed by Stage 4 local-search hits; then each Stage 5-16 chapter followed by its paired Notes, with source units in document order, owned images in manifest order, and that stage's local-search hits; then Stage 17 Index and local-search hits; then Stage 18 saturation results in round/result order. Epoch 1 may end after a partial canonical prefix. Any formally reopened blind pass increments the epoch before allocating IDs; its first history event is REOPEN only after the prior search-prefix closure, and later unread INITIAL paths continue in the active epoch's traversal order. IDs are allocated only by the root merge step.
candidate_id_policy.worker_policy: Isolated workers use stage-local W identifiers and never allocate B identifiers.
candidate_id_policy.reuse_policy: Never reuse or renumber an allocated B identifier.
candidate_id_policy.split_policy: The original ID becomes a SPLIT_SUPERSEDED tombstone and every child receives a new ID in canonical-evidence order. Every SPLIT_INTO relation carries a SPLIT_DISTINCTION proof plus explicit before_rationale and after_rationale; every evidence/link row is reassigned explicitly.
candidate_id_policy.merge_policy: Only a typed ALIAS_IDENTITY, CO_REFERENCE_IDENTITY, or PROVED_DUPLICATE_IDENTITY proof backed exclusively by DIRECT_IDENTITY evidence permits a blind-phase merge. Generic mechanics evidence never proves identity. The earliest ID remains active and every merged ID remains as a redirect record.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence states or unambiguously diagrams a transition, generation, replacement, evaluation, relation, constraint, probability, input-processing, or completion law over a defined object.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: The unit states only an observed outcome, behavioral property, rendering convention, application, analogy, or historical fact and supplies no native law or independently named coverage obligation.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence names or formally delimits a system and supplies at least one identity-bearing mechanic, even though other mechanics remain missing or cross-referenced.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: Only a name or Index entry occurs and no in-context Book passage supplies identity-bearing mechanics; record a route or identity-only evidence instead.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence gives a named or materially delimited preset, restriction, seed/input/boundary class, schedule, composition, or variant whose separate traceability could be lost if folded into another mention.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: The difference is merely a display choice, empirical observation, informal adjective, or duplicated wording with no coverage-bearing identity.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence defines a relation, constraint/model set, immutable function, constant, equation, axiom system, or query with a determinate denotation or accepted-result condition, whether or not it has native time evolution.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: The unit merely uses ordinary mathematics to describe another construction and does not define an independently queryable or coverage-bearing object.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: After reading the complete unit and context, there is a concrete, source-grounded possibility that native mechanics or a coverage-bearing identity is present but a defect, missing target, or underdetermination prevents resolution.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: Uncertainty comes only from not yet reading the available context or from external textbook expectations.

reading_disposition_rules.CANDIDATE: Use iff the unit satisfies at least one eligibility criterion and introduces or materially changes identity-bearing mechanics or a coverage-bearing obligation.
reading_disposition_rules.SUPPORTS_CANDIDATE: Use iff the unit contributes mechanics, parameters, restrictions, examples, or evidence to a B candidate but does not independently introduce its identity.
reading_disposition_rules.CROSS_REFERENCE: Use iff the unit's construction-relevant content is principally a route whose target must be read before mechanics can be established.
reading_disposition_rules.REPRESENTATION_OR_OBSERVER: Use iff the unit principally encodes, renders, measures, analyzes, transforms, or summarizes another object without supplying a new native law.
reading_disposition_rules.APPLICATION_OR_EMULATION: Use iff the unit principally applies, interprets, or emulates an identified construction without specifying a new native or coupling law.
reading_disposition_rules.HISTORICAL_ONLY: Use iff the unit concerns provenance, attribution, chronology, or terminology and supplies no mechanics or live route.
reading_disposition_rules.NO_CONSTRUCTION: Use iff complete in-context reading establishes that none of the other seven dispositions applies.
reading_disposition_rules.SOURCE_DEFECT_OR_AMBIGUITY: Use iff a source defect or genuine Book ambiguity blocks a sound primary disposition; record attempted resolution and any linked candidate or route.

disposition_precedence: SOURCE_DEFECT_OR_AMBIGUITY when the defect prevents a sound ordinary disposition
CANDIDATE when an eligibility criterion is met
SUPPORTS_CANDIDATE when mechanics support an existing candidate
CROSS_REFERENCE when routing is the unit's principal construction role

evidence_strengths.LEAD_ONLY: An Index entry, name, historical mention, or unresolved route locates possible evidence but proves no mechanics.
evidence_strengths.DIRECT_IDENTITY: Canonical evidence establishes the referent, scope, or formal role but no identity-critical native mechanic.
evidence_strengths.DIRECT_PARTIAL_MECHANICS: Canonical evidence directly fixes at least one identity-critical fingerprint field but cannot determine a complete native semantic judgment.
evidence_strengths.DIRECT_COMPLETE_MECHANICS: Canonical evidence fixes every field needed to reproduce or decide one native semantic judgment over the stated scope; every required field is supported or justified not applicable.
evidence_strengths.CORROBORATING: Canonical evidence independently supports a mechanic, parameter, alias, restriction, property, or provenance established by stronger evidence but does not become complete merely by repetition.
evidence_strengths.CONTEXTUAL: Behavior, analogy, application, proximity, rendering, or imagery supplies context but cannot establish identity-critical mechanics.
evidence_strengths.DEFECT_LIMITED: Available canonical evidence is damaged, contradictory, missing its target, or otherwise unable to decide the recorded mechanic; the exact boundary is stated.

evidence_application: Evidence strength is recorded per claim and per fingerprint field, never promoted by citation count to a candidate-wide scalar.
source_uncertainty_contract: Every reviewed source unit and screened asset records uncertainty independently of disposition or visual role. CLEAR requires an empty uncertainty boundary; AMBIGUOUS, DEFECTIVE, and CONFLICTING require a meaningful nonempty boundary. SOURCE_DEFECT_OR_AMBIGUITY and SOURCE_DEFECT cannot be CLEAR. Pending rows carry no adjudicated uncertainty.
review_epoch_contract: Every PENDING reading or asset row has a blank review_epoch. Every REVIEWED reading and SCREENED asset has the positive active global review_epoch of its latest immutable history event. INITIAL review may therefore occur in any active epoch, while a formal re-review opens the next epoch with REOPEN. Epoch 1 may end after a partial canonical prefix. Immutable SOURCE_UNIT and IMAGE anchors require a matching history event at the same epoch, not merely a current row whose latest epoch is later. For each (stage, epoch), exact LOCAL query-scope union comes only from immutable review-history paths, including a zero-discovery pass; every prior epoch's scopes are closed in the search prefix before the next epoch begins.
review_history_contract: review-history.jsonl is an append-only V###### hash chain. Each event covers exactly one canonical source path and records epoch, stage, INITIAL or REOPEN mode, reviewer, exact ordered source-unit and asset identities, immutable input and result projection hashes, and a hashed prior-search-round prefix. INITIAL consumes the first unread canonical path. A later epoch begins with REOPEN only after its recorded prior search prefix exactly closes every earlier history scope. Current REVIEWED/SCREENED rows equal the latest event covering them; pending rows have no event. Direct SOURCE_UNIT and IMAGE anchors have a history event at the same epoch.
visual_evidence_rule: An image may carry direct mechanics strength only after original-resolution inspection, contextual anchoring, and independent transcription/check. Otherwise its mechanics strength is CONTEXTUAL or DIRECT_PARTIAL_MECHANICS; hidden rule data, timing, colors, and coordinates are never inferred from proximity.
discovery_anchor_contract: Candidates and evidence use immutable {epoch, kind, id, ordinal} anchors. Routes use the corresponding CSV fields, review-history events bind direct source/image epochs, and search rounds record the same epoch. SOURCE_UNIT and IMAGE anchors belong to the owning sequential range and require an exact same-epoch history event; SEARCH_HIT anchors belong to a typed LOCAL or SATURATION round. Epoch 1 starts the canonical traversal but may stop after a partial prefix; every formal blind reopen increments the epoch only after prior-prefix LOCAL closure, and forward unread work continues in that active epoch. The global union of review-history, candidate, evidence, route, and search epochs is contiguous from 1; each non-review stream is epoch-monotone, preserves frozen stage/source traversal, and evidence cannot predate its candidate.

route_closure_scopes.WITHIN_STAGE: The expected target lies in the discovery stage and must close before that stage closes.
route_closure_scopes.CROSS_RANGE: The expected target lies outside the discovery stage and may remain queued until the target range is reviewed, but must close by Stage 18.

search_query_language.execution: Queries execute deterministically over decoded canonical source-unit byte ranges in query order and source-unit order. REGEX uses Unicode multiline semantics; case sensitivity and whole-word boundaries are explicit. Every recorded query/unit hit pair and context hash must equal an independent validator rerun.

unknown_value_policy: Every fingerprint key is present. Use UNKNOWN_FROM_SOURCE only after available in-scope context and routes have been exhausted, and duplicate the exact unresolved fact in missing_mechanics.

final_axis_rules.semantic_role_primary: Choose the primary role by the candidate's native result or judgment kind. Record stochasticity, branching, representation, application, and other cross-cutting facts as typed subtypes/relations where the primary vocabulary would otherwise overlap.
final_axis_rules.axis_local_insufficiency: Decide source insufficiency independently on each axis. A candidate may have a decided catalog action and semantic role while family action remains SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_FAMILY.
final_axis_rules.existing_family_reference: EXISTING_SEMANTIC_FAMILY means a family established in the final verified census, whether inherited from the pre-audit baseline or first established by another frozen B candidate; provenance records which.
final_axis_rules.failed_reuse_rule: Failure to prove same-family reuse is not proof of novelty. The only outcomes are proved reuse, proved non-preservation, or source-insufficient family evidence.

family_relation_rule: Native and declarative constructions have one own-family membership. Cross-cutting properties, seeds, representations, observers, applications, emulations, solvers, aliases, and compositions use one or more typed relations to affected families and are not forced into false membership. Independently specified mechanics are captured as a separate native candidate.

same_family: Complete source-grounded fingerprints exist for both sides.

Either a total structural/relational map on valid program/specification data and configurations/inputs, with an inverse on its valid image, commutes for one native semantic judgment, or both are proved instances/restrictions of one explicit typed parameterized schema with unchanged mechanics.

The preservation law matches object kind: transition commutation; pushforward equality of stochastic kernels; successor/multiplicity/witness bijection for nondeterminism; satisfaction/model/witness preservation for relations and constraints; domain/undefined/output preservation for partial functions; or denotational/flow commutation when no discrete event exists.

The proof preserves program data, complete state/denotation, invariants, target selection, schedule, read snapshot, effects or relation, successor cardinality/probability, completion/failure, witnesses, and native event granularity.
No hidden interpreter, phase clock, callback, opaque packing, lossy projection, or multi-step emulation supplies the correspondence.
A common-schema proof names substantive parameter domains and invariants; an auditor-invented universal schema, system-name switch, Any payload, or arbitrary callback is not a schema.
Failure of this packet proves only that reuse is unproved, never that a new family exists.
specialization_preset_property_seed: State the exact parameter restriction, predicate, constructor, property, or input law.
Prove native mechanics are otherwise unchanged with a counterfactual test: conditioned on the same realized program/configuration/input, erasing the label cannot change the native result.

For presets require a total validated constructor to an ordinary base specification; for specializations require subset closure; for properties require a non-causal predicate; for seeds/inputs/boundaries distinguish the admissible set or law from transition stochasticity and time-varying feedback.
State separately whether the Book identity still warrants catalog coverage.
composition_hybrid: Name every component construction and its typed specification, state, and ports.
State the joint state/invariants, coupling law, data flow, read/write ownership, event ordering/atomicity, conflicts, shared randomness/correlation, completion/failure, and witness combination.
Prove whether the coupling is ordinary composition or introduces an irreducible coupling algebra.
Do not hide one component in another component's opaque value.
representation_observer_application_emul: State the exact subtype and represented, observed, applied, or emulated construction.

Specify encode/decode and valid image for representations; observation map and any observer state/randomness for observers; interpretation/parameter binding for applications; and source/emulator encoding, decoding, schedule factor, preserved observables, errors, and termination scope for emulations.
Show that no new native law is specified, or capture that law as a separate candidate.
Apply the non-causality test: holding native program/state/input fixed, varying or removing the representation, observer, or interpretation cannot change the native result relation/distribution.
Keep encoding, rendering, measurement, solving, and decoding outside native events; multi-step emulation supports EMULATES but never proves same-family identity.
new_catalog_entry: Provide sufficient canonical Book identity and an evidence packet.
Assign one final semantic role and family action.
Show what traceable Book obligation would be lost by folding it into another catalog row.
Do not require family novelty merely because catalog coverage is new.
new_semantic_family: Provide sufficient canonical Book mechanics to instantiate the construction.

Define the plausible comparison set as all families sharing the native object/result kind, or justify an exhaustive narrower set; identify the nearest candidate/family and explain why alternatives cannot absorb the candidate.
Give a concrete native event, result, or denotation whose state, schedule, reads, probability, structure, successor cardinality, completion, or witnesses cannot be preserved by that family.
Show the difference is not a parameter, restriction, seed, representation, generic composition, observer, or another instance of one explicit parameterized schema.
source_insufficient: Exhaust all canonical context, local searches, and queued routes.
State exactly which identity or mechanic remains missing, damaged, or contradictory.
Separate facts established by the Book from external expectations.
Give at least two materially different completions consistent with the evidence when possible and state which catalog, role, or family decision each would change.
Apply insufficiency independently to each final axis and state a concrete reopen trigger.
Use the explicit source-insufficient final values rather than inventing semantics.

worker_isolation.context_mode: Use a sealed, hash-bound scratch bundle and an OS/filesystem sandbox when delegating blind discovery. Prompt-only restrictions in the shared repository are not evidence of input isolation.
allowed_inputs: a sanitized statement of Principle 0 and source-fidelity rules, without current architecture vocabulary
a sanitized discovery-only projection of goal-4/guardrails.json
a sanitized blind-worker brief that excludes current counts, candidate hypotheses, reconciliation vocabulary, API framing, and prohibited paths
the assigned canonical Markdown document or deterministic source-unit slice
only images owned by that assigned slice
blind ledger schemas and write-free validation instructions
forbidden_inputs: repository siblings not copied into the sealed bundle
other workers' candidate mappings before root merge
whole-corpus trigger searches before assigned sequential reading
output_contract: Use ordered worker-local W#### candidate, WR#### route, WE###### evidence, and WG###### evidence-group identifiers; only the root coordinator maps them to append-only global IDs.
Return source-unit dispositions, candidate proposals, image reviews, routes, and uncertainties only for the assigned range.
Include every required fingerprint key and never include a forbidden blind field.
Do not edit shared ledgers; the root merge allocates B IDs in canonical order and records provenance.
Return bundle, schema, prompt, allowed-file-manifest, and output hashes plus a declaration of prohibited-input nonuse.

blind_schema_policy.post_freeze_policy: After Stage 18, blind artifacts are content-hashed and immutable. Reconciliation uses separate join/classification artifacts and never adds fields to frozen blind records.

close_review_triggers: an eligible-looking source unit assigned NO_CONSTRUCTION
a blind candidate merge or split
a final NO_SEPARATE_CATALOG_ENTRY for a separately named or mechanically close referent
a same-family grouping between non-identical coverage identities
every proposed catalog addition or new semantic family
saturation_fixed_point: A full frozen-query round reproduces its result IDs/digest, every hit is dispositioned, all discovered aliases/operations/examples/parameters were included in that round's vocabulary, and the round adds zero vocabulary, candidates, evidence groups, or unresolved routes. A second identical rerun must reproduce the zero-delta result.
blind_freeze_requirements: All assigned canonical source units have exactly one primary reading disposition.
All physical images have a visual-screening record and all image references have an asset row.

Every immutable Stage 4 through 17 review-history (stage, epoch) scope has an exact LOCAL-round scope union before a later epoch can begin or that stage can close, including zero-discovery passes; the union of INITIAL history paths covers the full canonical audit traversal before the Stage 18 saturation fixed point.
Every local and saturation search hit has a final blind disposition.
Every relevant cross-reference is resolved or has an explicit defect boundary.
Every active candidate has every fingerprint key, complete provenance, and explicit missing mechanics.
Blind artifacts contain none of the forbidden blind fields.
Artifact hashes are frozen before any Stage 19 input is opened.
